title: Play Console and App Store Connect: accounts, roles and fees

videos.script:
Before an app reaches a store, somebody has to open an account there. {{accounts}} And the account decides more than people expect: whose name appears as the seller, who may press release, and who receives the money.

Both stores charge for it. {{fees}} Google once, Apple every year. And both take a share of every sale, which you can work out before you set a price.

Today you do that sum. {{script}} A short script that turns a price into what actually reaches you, and counts how many sales pay for the accounts.

And one decision matters more than the rest. {{holder}} One person holds each account, and on Apple's side nobody else can sign its agreements. Choose that person on purpose.
